ui_bugs.issue: The fixed FormWise panel sits on top of the nudge in the top-right of /demo. When the panel is open (default state on desktop) the nudge-dismiss-btn X is covered by the panel tab bar (tab-field-help intercepts pointer-events). The JS handler works when invoked directly (sessionStorage 'fw_nudge_dismissed'='1' persists correctly, nudge stays hidden after reload), but a real user cannot click the X on desktop. Consider (a) moving the X slightly left of the panel edge, (b) placing the nudge inside the main content grid so the right rail cannot cover it, or (c) increasing right padding on the nudge container to keep the X in the visible column.

issues: Nudge is present in DOM but fully covered by the mobile FormWise panel (panel is full-viewport on mobile). Not a functional break — the nudge appears once user closes the panel — but users may never see it. Consider showing the nudge inside the panel body for mobile, or auto-collapsing the panel until a field is focused.

action_items: Consider fixing the desktop overlay: the signed-out signin-nudge dismiss X is behind the sticky FormWise panel. Behaviour (session-scoped hide) works correctly when invoked; only pointer-events are blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: SKIP_KEYWORDS + section-based skip correctly excludes guardian/emergency/out-of-india rows even though 'name' otherwise matches to full_name — verified end-to-end.

match_option's substring fallback (`v in low or low in v`) will match 'Male' -> 'Male' but also risks matching e.g. 'M' -> 'Male' and 'Male' -> 'Female' (contains 'male'). Passport gender 'Male'/'Female' happen to work, but consider requiring word-boundary/equality before falling back to substring.

form_requirements.py returns the same dict object every call (module-level constant). Fine today because handlers don't mutate it, but downstream code accepting `dict` should treat it as read-only or return a deepcopy.
SignInNudge dismiss button is absolutely positioned top-2 right-2 inside a container that on desktop sits under the fixed panel (right 0). This is the root cause of the overlay bug above.
extension config.js is now a `var` — sensible for classic-script inclusion in panel/index.html. Ensure any bundler that expects an ES module for the same file continues to work.

rca of the issue: nudge-dismiss-btn overlay: SignInNudge renders its X with `absolute top-2 right-2` inside the /demo main column. The FormWise HelperPanel (fixed / right: 0 / width ~420px) is on top of that same right edge, so elementFromPoint over the X returns the panel's tab-field-help button instead of the X. Fix options: (1) shrink the nudge container's right padding so the X sits ~440px+ from the viewport right, (2) render the nudge inside a column that ends before the panel, (3) portal the X to a location outside the panel's coverage. Impact: cosmetic — users can still sign in via the primary button, and the banner won't be shown again after they sign in.
